narrative.northStar: Galet et feuille: calm sheets resting on pebbles
narrative.overview:
Carnet is a notebook of calm paper sheets resting on pebbles, after its own mark (a beige card on a matcha pebble). Every container is a smooth sheet with one continuous corner, the same for every item of a role and at every size, so a hundred notes read as one quiet wall. The brand's pebble is the one organic form: it marks what is chosen, captured or kept (the capture pebble, the chosen place, the open info, a collection's emblem on its stone, a picture glimpsed), and it never holds text. The palette is habits-garden's: paper ground, cream sheets, warm near-black ink, terracotta fills, a matcha accent and fourteen earth pigments.

Density is Keep's: two columns on the phone, as many as fit on the desktop, each card exactly as tall as its content. One humanist face (Signika) at fixed sizes, weight carrying rank. Depth is paper resting on paper: a hairline edge, one soft light, quiet grain never stacked. Motion is short and settling; a pebble pressed gives rounder and springs back, sheets never change shape; the snip is the one authored moment. Both clients paint from the same data in `src/core/design/` (palette, shapes, outline, pebbles, backgrounds, emblems, glyphs, collage, mark), so the phone (Android, primary) and the web twin cannot drift. The research behind the corner, the radius scale and keeping organic forms off text is in `docs/DESIGN-RESEARCH.md`.

Rejected by the direction contract and the owner (2026-10-22): per-item random outlines, wobbling or bowed edges, organic shapes holding text, ornamented chrome, Keep's plain rounded rectangles, the old metro's navy signage. Kept owner pins: green only as the matcha accent; icons and checkboxes neutral on any note colour; nothing behind an icon's line but a pebble tint; no shadow behind any icon, emblem or illustration; hovers and presses stay inside the control and never tilt or jump.
keyCharacteristics: Sheets: one continuous corner (Figma's, smoothing 0.6) from a short radius scale by role, capped at 0.3 of the shorter side, nested concentrically, a hairline edge.
One pebble: the mark's stone, stretched to its box and turned one of four ways, never under text; pressed, it gives toward round and springs back.
Controls are soft sheets: their radius stays under half their height, never a capsule.
Terracotta for filled actions and links; matcha for capture, the chosen, focus and switches.
Earth pigments only on emblems, label tags, stones' washes and note washes; a note may also wear a soft mesh gradient, and a paper (dots, grid, lines) under either.
A hover or press is a tint laid inside the control's own shape, never a ripple past it, a tilt or a jump.
Line icons: Phosphor's Bold line alone; eleven glyphs take their Fill form when their control is selected.
Cut-outs hand-cut after Matisse: emblems and the label tag, flat, no cast shadow.
Quiet grain on the ground and on every sheet, never stacked.
System messages on a charcoal slip, dark in both modes.

rules.name: The Pigment Belongs To Cut-Outs Rule
rules.body: Pigments fill emblems, label tags and the snip's cut; a note and a stone wear the pigment's wash or a gradient, never the pigment itself. Chrome stays paper, terracotta and matcha. On a page, the person's own words may take a pigment's text ink or its wash, and code takes text inks: content, never chrome.

rules.name: The Terracotta Acts, Matcha Chooses Rule
rules.body: Terracotta fills and links; matcha marks capture, what is chosen, what has focus and what is switched on.

rules.name: The Green Is Only Matcha Rule
rules.body: Green appears only as matcha (the accent, and the sync dot's deep matcha): no neutral, night ground or veil carries a green cast, and icons and checkboxes stay neutral ink on any note colour.

rules.name: The Paper Under Pigment Rule
rules.body: A pigment never sits on the matcha fill. The chosen navigation place puts a collection's cut-out or a label's tag on its own wash pebble, a glyph on matcha; a picker marks a chosen cut-out with a paper pebble ringed in matcha.

rules.name: The Contrast Test Rule
rules.body: A new colour, wash or gradient enters `palette.ts` or `backgrounds.ts` and passes its contrast test, or it does not ship: ink 7:1 and the second ink 4.5:1 on every paper, wash and gradient; `edge` 3:1 on every ground; a well 1.15 against the wall and 1.1 against a card; a disabled label 4.5:1 in its well; the sync dots 3:1 on the strip.

rules.name: The Family Not Weight Rule
rules.body: On the phone set `fontFamily` (`Signika-Bold`, `SignikaNight-Medium`, the `labelStrong` variant), never `fontWeight`: each weight is its own family.

rules.name: The One Size Per Card Rule
rules.body: Card title and body share 15px; a hundred cards must never read as a hundred headlines.

rules.name: The Shadow Moves, Text Never Does Rule
rules.body: Hover lifts a card from Card to Raised; selection is a ring laid over the sheet; content never shifts, and nothing tilts or jumps under the pointer.

rules.name: The Flat Cut-Out Rule
rules.body: Nothing cast or drawn on the paper has a shadow: emblems, stones, collage pieces, swatches, the tick pebble and the capture pebble lie flat. Lifts belong to sheets of paper.

rules.name: The Quiet Grain Rule
rules.body: Grain at 0.16 by day and 0.08 at night (`GRAIN`, `web/build/tokens.ts`), tiled at 200 from a 256 procedural source; one layer per surface, never stacked, never on photos.

rules.name: The Calm Wall Rule
rules.body: One continuous corner per role from `RADII`, the same for every item and every size, capped at 0.3 of the shorter side and concentric when nested. Never a seed, a random corner, a bowed side or a radius invented outside the scale.

rules.name: The Soft Sheet Control Rule
rules.body: A control's radius stays under half its height (a button 13 at 48, a field 13 at 52, the strip 15 at 54): it reads as a soft sheet, never a capsule, so Firefox without `corner-shape` draws what Chromium draws.

rules.name: The Pebble Holds No Text Rule
rules.body: The pebble marks what is chosen, captured or kept, and crops glimpsed pictures; text always sits on a sheet. A link's own picture keeps its 4:5 frame, so products compare whole.

dos: Do take every radius from `RADII` by role (`SHAPES`, `OUTLINES`; `--cut-*` on the web, `corners(SHAPES.role)` or `outline="kind"` on an `Organic` or `Tappable` on the phone), concentric when nested.
Do keep a control's radius under half its height, so it reads as a soft sheet in every browser.

Do use the pebble for what is chosen, captured or kept and for glimpsed pictures (`data-pebble`, `data-pebble-under`, `pebble` on the phone), each row's neighbours on different turns and a collection's stone on `pebbleTurnOf(id)`.
Do let a pressed pebble give and spring back (90 in, 380 back); keep sheets still.
Do take every colour from `palette.ts` or `backgrounds.ts` through the theme or `var(--…)`, and pass its contrast test.
Do edge cards, chips and bars with the 1px hairline; menus, dialogs, sheet lips and field-like strips with the outline; a control drawn by its edge alone with `edge`.
Do fill actions in terracotta, write links in deep terracotta, and mark capture, the chosen, focus and switches in matcha; keep tonal buttons matcha wash.
Do hover and press inside the control's own shape: 6% of the control's ink under a hovering pointer and 10% under the press (a link-coloured control: 8% and 12%).
Do put grain on the ground and on every sheet at the theme's strength, one layer per surface.
Do lift paper with the shared lifts only: Card at rest, Raised for hover, Float for sheets, dialogs, menus, the drawer and the slip.
Do size a board card from its content with `layoutCard` (`wall.ts`), never by measuring it.
Do keep a link's own picture in its 4:5 frame.
Do settle arrivals on decelerate within 150, 250 or 300ms, and send departures off faster on accelerate.
Do keep Signika alone, set by family on the phone, with the night grade after dark.
donts: Don't give an item its own random corners, a seeded outline or bowed sides; every item of a role takes the same radius.
Don't round a control into a capsule or a container past `CORNER_CAP`.
Don't put text on a pebble, or crop a link's own picture to one.
Don't put a stone in a navigation row other than the chosen place's.
Don't float or round the drawer; it runs the full height, square and flush.
Don't paint chrome, text or a whole note in a pigment; notes and stones wear a wash.
Don't use matcha for a filled action or terracotta for selection or focus.
Don't lay a pigment on the matcha fill: a chosen cut-out sits on its own wash or on paper.
Don't bounce anything but the snip's landing and the pebble's spring back.
Don't grow anything from nothing: arrivals start at 0.9 or more.
Don't unmount an overlay before its exit has played.
Don't set uppercase anywhere but the stamp.
Don't draw anything behind an icon's line but its control's pebble tint.
Don't fade a disabled button's pigment or opacity; it sinks to a well.
Don't cast a shadow behind an icon, emblem, stone, swatch, pebble or illustration.
Don't tilt, lift, translate or grow a control under the pointer (static turns such as the stamp, a stone's emblem and the ghost emblem are drawn, not hovers).
Don't stack grain on a nested surface.
Don't hard-code a hex, a radius or a shadow in a component; the web reads generated custom properties, the phone reads the theme.
